dating.text: 馆方给出了年代，**但未在公开记录中说明这个年代依据什么**——是铭文、器形序列、共出器物还是风格比对，无从得知。本库的断代十档因此无法填写：**填任何一档都是替馆方作了它没作的声明。**

colophons.text:
Artist's inscription, signature, and 2 seals:

Row after row of misty trees envelop the Buddhist Monastery./
But the rustic who comes to find it will not lose his way./
Just across the wooden bridge, the dusty world is cut off;/
Among the countless falling petals, birds are singing confusedly.

Daofu 道複 composed [this]. [seals] Fufu shi 復甫; Baiyang shanren 白陽山人.  
trans. WKH/LYSL
1 additional unidentified seal on the back of the mounting.
